data.name: SHRD0046_description
data.value: Checks whether a family has 6 or more types beyond the default type. [Autodesk Help: Create a Type Catalog](https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-FFA71D72-D4C5-416D-BF65-1757657C3CE9)

data.name: SHRD0046_message
data.value: Family '{familyName}' ({elementId}) has {typeCount} types beyond the default type and no type catalog. Autodesk recommends a type catalog for families with 6 or more types.

data.name: SHRD0046_message_with_catalog
data.value: Family '{familyName}' ({elementId}) has {typeCount} types beyond the default type and a type catalog '{catalogName}'. Autodesk recommends a type catalog for families with 6 or more types.

data.name: SHRD0047_description
data.value: Checks whether a family keeps types that its type catalog does not list. [Autodesk Help: Load a Family with a Type Catalog](https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-5DB0797C-B0CA-4C3F-B72A-84176738AEC5)

data.name: SHRD0047_message
data.value: Family '{familyName}' ({elementId}) has types that its type catalog '{catalogName}' does not list: {typeNames}.

data.name: SHRD0048_description
data.value: Checks whether a family stores its own types inside the family and in a type catalog at the same time. [Autodesk Help: Load a Family with a Type Catalog](https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-5DB0797C-B0CA-4C3F-B72A-84176738AEC5)

data.name: SHRD0048_message
data.value: Family '{familyName}' ({elementId}) uses its own types and the type catalog '{catalogName}' at the same time (types of its own: {ownTypeCount}, catalog types: {catalogTypeCount}).

data.name: SHRD0049_description
data.value: Checks whether the type catalog lists every family type parameter. [Autodesk Help: Create a Type Catalog](https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-FFA71D72-D4C5-416D-BF65-1757657C3CE9)

data.name: SHRD0049_message
data.value: Family '{familyName}' ({elementId}): type catalog '{catalogName}' does not list parameters: {parameterNames}. A type loaded from the catalog keeps the default values for them.
